newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady to touch firmer, diesel sought.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady to touch firmer, diesel sought.

text.p: NWE gas oil ticked a touch higher on Monday despite narrowly easier IPE futures.

April IPE gas oil last traded 25 down at $162 and was under pressure to head lower. Gas oil premiums, however, were a touch firmer for most grades on a combination of tightening avails and the continued arb to Asia.
The spotlight remained on diesel today with up to six buyers looking for product from one, possibly two sellers.
There were rumours of a 50-60kt done into Scandinavia, although most players thought it more likely material would be sold from the region.

A bid of April IPE +$11 cif NWE was heard, although no offer was set against it. One potential seller was thought to have withdrawn its cargo. A bid of April IPE +$12 was also heard basis Le Havre for specific dates.

Traders said Russian cargoes were assessed around April IPE +$1-2 cif NWE, but that material was very hard to find for large "arb friendly" cargoes. A Black Sea Russian 28kt sold at a strong number - high fob quotes +$3.75.
FOD attracted a touch more interest with a robust bid of April IPE +$5 for narrow 20-25 dates and most dealers notionally put the market around April IPE +$3-5 cif NWE from +$2-4.
-- Matthew Jones, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
